senses.definition: The third of four stages of development that the world goes through as part of the cycle of yugas; it lasts for 864,000 years.
The process of formatting video and audio files, building interactive menus, and setting chapter points so a disc plays correctly in a standard DVD player.
A device that permanently records (burns) information onto a DVD.
An optical drive used for reading data from and possibly writing data on a DVD.
An electronic device for playing DVDs.
A bay in Arkhangelsk Oblast in northwestern Russia, one of four large bays and gulfs of the White Sea.

An important structural theorem in the theory of Banach spaces, essentially stating that every sufficiently high-dimensional normed vector space will have low-dimensional subspaces that are approximately Euclidean.
